title: Box 34
logline: Box 34's lid: the register line for the summer's pages — An August, the tavern, the stone head — and the flaps shut. The page keeps the count in the year the town got its other story.

panels.composition: Close on a cardboard box lid with a number and two pencilled lines beneath it, flaps shut, on a stack of others, lamplight.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a cardboard box lid marked with a number and two pencilled lines beneath it, flaps shut, on a stack of other boxes in lamplight, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
